job.value: See what's for sale or up for auction in this show and act on one

arrivedFrom.value: The 'Shop' button on the live show

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Shop' title and tabs 'All / Auction / Buy Now / Giveaway' over a list of lots make it clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Buy now' is the only button, so Buy Now items stand out while the auction and giveaway rows have no visible action.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Buy now' is clear, but the share icon top-right doesn't say whether it shares the show or the shop.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Starting bid', 'Bid duration 00:10', 'Bid on any lot to join giveaway' and '56 entries' explain themselves.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The buyer only chooses what interests them.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each row shows just price and one status line; detail is a tap away.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is a lot in this show.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Prices and short labels carry the list.
